verses.1: So said Jehovah: “Enter the palace of the king of Judah, and speak those words there.”
verses.2: And you said, “Hear the word of the LORD, King of Judah, who sits on the throne of David. You and your servants, along with your people who come through these gates.”
verses.3: Thus said Jehovah: Let them make judgments and justice. Let them save the oppressed from the hands of those who oppress them. Let them not harm the poor or the weak. And let they not shed blood in this place.
verses.4: For if they do this, and come into the rooms of this house, then kings will sit on David’s throne. They will ride in chariots and on horses. And they will be with their servants and people.
verses.5: And if you do not listen to these words, then I will curse this house, says the LORD. For destruction will come upon this house.
verses.6: For thus said Jehovah regarding the house of King Yehuda: Gilad, you are the head of our nation. If I do not destroy you by destroying your cities, then no one will rule over us.
verses.7: And I will sanctify you with oil, and all your utensils. I will select them from among your offerings, and place them on the altar.
verses.8: And many nations passed by this city. They said to each other, “What has Jehovah done to this great city?”
verses.9: And they said, “They have broken the covenant of Jehovah their God. They have worshiped other gods and served them instead.”
verses.10: Do not die, and do not be sad about it. Do not weep over those who have gone away, for they will never return to see the land where they were born again.
verses.11: For thus said Jehovah to Shalum, son of Josiah, king of Judah: “The king who ruled under his father Josiah will not return there again.”
verses.12: For in that place where he was revealed, he died. And he will never see that land again.
verses.13: He builds his house without justice, and his structures are not based on fairness. He will be punished for his actions, and his efforts will not be rewarded.
verses.14: He said, “Let me have a house of laws and righteousness. Let my friends be blessed, and let my enemies be destroyed.”
verses.15: May he reign, for you have obeyed the laws of your father. Then he will eat and drink, and he will judge fairly and justly. Then it will be good for him.
verses.16: May the poor and needy be blessed. May this knowledge be with me, O LORD.
verses.17: For your eyes and your heart are not capable of seeing or understanding anything. They are only focused on your own desires, on the blood that must be shed, on those who are to be punished, and on those who are to be executed.
verses.18: Therefore, as Jehovah said to Jehoykim, son of Josiah, king of Judah: “They shall not offer him sacrifices. They shall not offer him any offerings or gifts.”
verses.19: The dead body of Hamor will be buried in Sachew, and then thrown away from there to the streets of Jerusalem.
verses.20: I will cry out in pain, and my voice will be heard in the wilderness. I will cry out for help, because all your lovers have been defeated.
verses.21: I have spoken to you in my quietness. You said, “I will not listen to this from your way of speaking.” For you did not hear my voice at all.
verses.22: All your enemies will be destroyed, and your lovers will go away. Then you will be freed from all your troubles.
verses.23: You sit in the throne, surrounded by pillars made of wood. When you come here, you are like a newborn child.
verses.24: May the Lord live on, for if there were a son of Jehovah, who could be king over Judah, then he would rule through my right hand. From there, I will give you dominion.
verses.25: And you were given into the hands of those who seek to harm your soul. You were also given into the hands of those whom you yourself would have to defend against them. You were also given into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, and into the hands of the enemies.
verses.26: And I will take you and your mother, who gave birth to you on this earth, and I will bring them to the place where they were not born. There, they will die.
verses.27: And on the earth, those who carry their souls there, will never return there again.
verses.28: The sorrow spread everywhere. This man, Canaan, was destroyed. There was no hope for him. His descendants were also destroyed and thrown onto the earth, where they would never know what happened to them.
verses.29: Earth, earth, land where the words of Jehovah are heard.
verses.30: So said Jehovah: “They have written down this man as being blind from birth. He will not be able to succeed in his lifetime, because no one can sit on David’s throne and rule over Judah from his descendants.”
